description: NEGATIVE FIXTURE (issue #1115): a deliberately-broken copy of unified-vault-seam-map.json with the contracts/PortfolioRouter.sol hot-file entry REMOVED. scripts/validate-seam-map MUST exit non-zero on this file. Used by the validator self-test so a silent regression in the validator cannot let a seam-map that drops a hot file ship.

open_questions_resolved.question: TWAP/oracle pricing extraction boundary — does pricing stay vault-side or move into adapters?
open_questions_resolved.resolution: Adapters self-price. Each AssetPositionAdapter owns its TWAP window config (or Chronicle NAV + heartbeat) and produces USDC-denominated totalAssets(); the vault only sums Sigma adapter.totalAssets(). Pricing is NOT wholly delegated: the vault retains one adapter-INDEPENDENT residual price sanity check (a single global aggregate-NAV growth-rate cap on the deposit path, spec 4.3a) so a mis-scaling adapter that passes its own probe is still bounded.

open_questions_resolved.question: Does BasketVault library-linking (TickMath and friends) carry into the unified Vault under EIP-170?
open_questions_resolved.resolution: Flagged as an EIP-170 spike INPUT for #1119, not decided here. ADR-0010 records that EIP-170 pressure MOVES (swap/TWAP code leaves the vault into adapters) but does not disappear (the vault adds the realized-delta core, dual preview math, dual redemption/fee paths, residual price check). Whether library-linking survives into the unified Vault must be PROVEN by the Phase-2 spike; the linked TickMath moves down into the AssetPositionAdapter codehash. #1127 owns the EIP-170 size gate.
open_questions_resolved.spec_ref: ADR-0010 Consequences (M-A2); unified-vault-spec.md 4.2 (linked TickMath in adapter codehash)

open_questions_resolved.question: Which per-asset guards move to adapters vs stay vault-side?
open_questions_resolved.resolution: Per the resolution doc: the GLOBAL residual price limiter (aggregate NAV-growth-rate cap) stays VAULT-side as a deposit circuit-breaker (#1120); per-asset TWAP-derived swap floors, the ORA-4 NAV-deviation guard, per-asset emergency-unwind guards, pool-usability preconditions, and Chronicle heartbeat move INTO the adapters (#1118/#1121/#1126). The vault keeps one maxSlippageBps for preview math + the min-out it passes per call, plus the vault-stored (timelock-set) emergency floor it passes into drains (M-S2). Adapter config setters are gated by onlyVaultAdmin (transitive vault ADMIN), carrying no independent role tree.

contracts/RobotMoneyVault.sol.role: The general-case adapter allocator whose architecture the unification is built on. Becomes the unified `Vault` (superset), NOT retired into a subclass.
contracts/RobotMoneyVault.sol.unification_direction: RobotMoneyVault's IStrategyAdapter registry is the general case; basket assets are made to look like adapters. The vault stays pure USDC-in/USDC-out.
extraction: Nothing venue-specific to shed — RobotMoneyVault has no swap/TWAP/oracle code; it is already asset-agnostic (this is why it is the base for unification, not BasketVault).
insertion: Realized-delta `_deposit` core (route USDC into adapters first, mint on realized NAV delta with slippage-floor revert) ported from BasketVault AZ-BSK-1, degenerating to exact for lending adapters (#1119).
Idle-inclusive OZ mint denominator (`taBefore - revokedIdle + 1`); AZ-BSK-3 idle exclusion applies ONLY to recovered USDC from a revoked/excluded adapter (#1119).

`allExact()`-gated dual accounting/redemption: exact mode keeps `_pullProportional` + `InsufficientAdapterLiquidity` + fee-on-gross; inexact mode uses BasketVault no-revert `_sellProportional` + `_lastWithdrawnAssets` + fee-on-realized (#1119).
Vault-attested `AdapterInfo.isExact` bool + `allExact()` registry-visible flag + `ExactnessTransition` timelock/event on class flip; `maxWithdraw/maxRedeem == 0` when `!allExact()` (#1123).
Residual adapter-independent price sanity check: single vault-wide aggregate-NAV growth-rate checkpoint on the deposit path (#1120).
Atomic `EMERGENCY_ROLE` arm+execute emergency model; split pause (`depositsPaused`/`withdrawalsPaused`) replacing single `paused()`; vault-side emergency floor + `reabsorbRevokedAdapter` (#1121).

`forceRebalance`-only composition correction: ordinary deposit and withdrawal flow is composition-blind (never targets a deficit or surplus); self-funded NAV-non-decreasing `forceRebalance` is the sole lever that ever moves composition toward target (#1122, rebalancing model corrected by #1154/#1155).
shared_state: AdapterInfo[] registry (adapter, capBps, active, isExact) — mutated by #1119 (structure), #1123 (isExact field), #1120 (NAV checkpoint neighbor).
`adapterAllowed` allowlist + `adapterCodeHashAllowed` codehash pinning — carried over uniformly.
FEE-2 realized-proceeds fee accounting — extended to cover basket themes.
`totalAssets()` = idle USDC + Sigma eligible adapter.totalAssets() — read by #1119/#1120/#1122 and the router preflight.

contracts/vaults/BasketVault.sol.role: Donor of the realized-delta accounting core and no-revert sell path; source of nearly all EXTRACTION into adapters. Retired as a class in v2 (themes become Vault deployments).
extraction: Swap execution (`_executeSwap`, inline-V3 `adapter == address(0)` special case) → AssetPositionAdapter via one IBasketSwapAdapter seam; a concrete UniswapV3SwapAdapter replaces the inline path (#1118).
TWAP config (`twapWindow`, `setTwapWindow`, MIN/MAX/DEFAULT_TWAP_WINDOW, `effectiveTwapWindow`) → adapter storage + setter, bounds/fallback/event verbatim (#1118).
ORA-4 NAV-deviation guard (`navDeviationGuardBps`, `setNavDeviationGuardBps`, MAX_NAV_DEVIATION_BPS, `NavMarketDeviationExceeded`) → adapter, entry-side only inside `deploy()` (#1118).
Per-asset `EmergencyUnwindGuard` + `setEmergencyUnwindGuard` + `emergencyUnwindWithOverride` → adapter, driven by vault atomic-EMERGENCY path (#1121/#1126).
Pool-usability preconditions (`MIN_POOL_CARDINALITY`, `MIN_POOL_LIQUIDITY`, `InsufficientObservationHistory`, ORA-3 execution==TWAP pool) → adapter CONSTRUCTOR preconditions (#1118).
Chronicle heartbeat (`oracleHeartbeat`, MAX_HEARTBEAT, `StalePriceFeed`), stale-unwind override → deSPXA adapter variant (#1126).
insertion: Its realized-delta `_deposit` (AZ-BSK-1/-3), `_sellProportional`, `RedeemOnly`, `_lastMintedShares`/`_lastWithdrawnAssets`, and fee-on-realized semantics are INSERTED into the unified Vault as the inexact-mode branch (#1119).
AZ-BSK-2 realized-return `deposit()`/`redeem()` overrides move into the unified Vault for router-leg comparison (#1119).
shared_state: AssetInfo {token, pool, swapFee, adapter, venue} — decomposed into adapter constructor immutables; registering an asset becomes `Vault.addAdapter` (#1118/#1119).

`maxSlippageBps` / `MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS` (500) / `minSlippageFloorBps` (L-17 brick guard) — split: vault keeps preview-math slippage + `minOutFloorBps()` max-over-adapters; adapter enforces venue amountOutMinimum (#1118/#1119).

contracts/vaults/.role: The BasketVault subclass family (ProtocolAssetVault/AgentTokenVault/RwaVault) — dissolved: themes become Vault deployments differing only in adapter set + params, not Solidity subclasses.
extraction: `RwaVault.totalAssets` SUP-5 idle-USDC redemption short-circuit → adapter (zero balance returns 0 without oracle read) (#1118/#1126).
Per-subclass adapter/venue wiring → per-theme deploy scripts (rmPROTO Uniswap V3, rmAGENT mixed V3/V4/Aerodrome, rmRWA Chronicle Aerodrome) (#1129).
rmAGENT shortlist wiring (`config/agent-token-shortlist.json`) → Phase-4 adapter set, per-theme TimelockController as adapter admin (ADR-0004) (#1124/#1125/#1129).
insertion: No new subclass files — the family is REPLACED by parameterized Vault deployments; the only new contracts under this tree are the deployment configs/scripts, not vault classes (#1129).
Theme matrix (shares, adapter set, isExact, maxSlippageBps, maxActiveAdapters, pricing) becomes deploy-time configuration consumed by #1129.
shared_state: Shared lifecycle machinery (pause, shutdown/restore, retirement, fee accounting, TVL caps) — unified once on the Vault, no longer duplicated per subclass.
Theme deployment matrix (spec 8) — read by #1129 deploy scripts and #1127 per-composition conformance suites.

contracts/adapters/.role: Insertion target for everything extracted from BasketVault. Existing lending adapters retrofit to IPositionAdapter; new AssetPositionAdapters are added per basket asset per venue.
extraction: Nothing leaves this tree — it is the destination. The existing IStrategyAdapter implementations (AaveV3Adapter/CompoundV3Adapter/MorphoAdapter) shed only their old `IStrategyAdapter` signatures (see that file's entry).
insertion: Retrofit MorphoAdapter/AaveV3Adapter/CompoundV3Adapter to IPositionAdapter: `deploy(usdcIn,minValueOut) returns valueAdded` (return usdcIn, require >= minValueOut), `withdraw(usdcWanted,minUsdcOut)` (require usdcOut >= minUsdcOut), hardcoded `isExact() => true`; MorphoAdapter.maxExposure unchanged (#1117).
New `AssetPositionAdapter` base: token custody, swap via IBasketSwapAdapter, TWAP pricing, ORA-4 guard, emergency-unwind guard, `isExact() => false` (#1118).
New `UniswapV3SwapAdapter` venue executor replacing the inline-V3 special case (#1118).
Uniswap V4 AssetPositionAdapter with `hooks == address(0)` asserted at construction (M-S6) (#1124).
Aerodrome AssetPositionAdapter (#1125).
Chronicle-priced deSPXA AssetPositionAdapter: heartbeat staleness, freeze-safe, zero-balance oracle short-circuit (#1126).
onlyVaultAdmin modifier querying `AccessControl(VAULT).hasRole(ADMIN_ROLE, .)` — adapters carry no independent role tree (#1118).
shared_state: IPositionAdapter frozen surface (contracts/interfaces/IPositionAdapter.sol) — every adapter in this tree implements it; changes coordinate through #1116.
adapter codehash pinned by the vault (bakes venue-executor address + linked TickMath) — read by #1119 registration.
Protected-token / foreign-token union set (M-S4/INV-2) — each adapter's custodied token must be in the vault's sweep-protected union (#1118/#1119).

contracts/interfaces/IStrategyAdapter.so.role: The v1 adapter boundary superseded by IPositionAdapter. Frozen-surface origin.
extraction: The v1 signatures `deploy(uint256)`, `withdraw(uint256) returns (actual)`, `totalAssets`, `harvestRewards`, `sweepForeignToken` are superseded by the wider IPositionAdapter signatures; the min-out-less deploy/withdraw shapes leave the adapter surface (#1116/#1117).
The deployed v1 `RobotMoneyVault` and its live IStrategyAdapter instances are UNTOUCHED and retire per ADR-0009 — this file itself is not deleted while v1 remains referenced.
insertion: IPositionAdapter (new file, this PR's stub) inserts the superset surface: min-out params, realized-value return on deploy, `isExact()`, and the mandatory `USDC()`/`VAULT()` identity views (#1116).
`isExact()` cross-check semantics (registration-time only, never per-call gate) are added at the boundary (#1116/#1123).
shared_state: harvestRewards / sweepForeignToken semantics carried verbatim into IPositionAdapter — no consumer change.
`type(uint256).max` withdraw-all sentinel and the `withdraw` clamp-vs-revert contract preserved (relied on by `_pullProportional`).

contracts/interfaces/IBasketSwapAdapter..role: The venue-execution seam (ADR-0005). Retained UNCHANGED; consumer moves from the vault to the AssetPositionAdapter.
extraction: Consumption of this seam moves OUT of BasketVault (`_executeSwap`) — the vault no longer calls IBasketSwapAdapter directly (#1118).
The inline-V3 `adapter == address(0)` path that bypassed this seam is removed; every venue now goes through the seam via a concrete executor (#1118).
insertion: AssetPositionAdapter becomes the sole consumer of IBasketSwapAdapter (AerodromeSwapAdapter/UniswapV4SwapAdapter/ChronicleOracleAdapter remain stateless executors) (#1118/#1124/#1125).
A new `UniswapV3SwapAdapter` executor is added behind this seam (interface itself unchanged) (#1118).
Approval hygiene (`forceApprove(venue, amount)` / `forceApprove(venue, 0)`, ADP-5) carried verbatim into the adapter's call sites (#1118).
shared_state: The IBasketSwapAdapter interface signatures — FROZEN, not modified by this phase; only the caller changes.
Venue enum (V3/V4/Aerodrome, Chronicle-priced Aerodrome) becomes an adapter immutable, replacing AssetInfo.venue (#1118/#1126).

contracts/VaultRegistry.sol.role: Vault registry + router-eligibility gate. Holds the ADR-0002 stale-default-weights interlock (`setRouterEligible` reverts StaleDefaultWeightsLength) that deadlocks Phase-6 migration.
extraction: No behavior is extracted OUT of the registry; the migration seam is the eligibility+weights atomicity fix, added here (#1128).
insertion: Atomic eligibility+weights interlock fix (`VaultRegistry.sol:335-340`): an atomic `migrateEligibility` that swaps the eligibility flag + default vector in one call, OR a registry-level attestation home — chosen so registering a v2 vault (moving `routerEligibleCount`) no longer reverts `StaleDefaultWeightsLength` (#1128).

Optional registry-level `isExact`/`allExact` attestation home (the alternative to vault-attested, spec Open decision) — recorded as an insertion point but this ADR pins vault-attested at addAdapter; registry stays the fallback location (#1123/#1128).
v1 retire/unretire path exercised for the v1->v2 migration (`retire(v1)` after eligibility migration; withdrawals stay open on v1 indefinitely, ADR-0009) (#1130).
shared_state: `routerEligibleCount` + `setRouterEligible` — the deadlock surface co-owned with PortfolioRouter default weights (#1128/#1130).
retire()/unretire() lifecycle — reused for v1 retirement, unchanged semantics.

CI four-vault assertions (suite-14 demo_seeding asserts exactly four Active vaults; suite-01 hardcoded subclass names; suite-16 ABI-drift; suite-22 CoverageMap) — must be rewritten for variable v2 vault counts (#1131).
